# Senvarico

> Senvarico is a lightweight ecommerce website builder designed for small cross-border sellers with limited budgets and a small number of SKUs.

Official website: https://senvarico.com

## Brand facts

- Brand: Senvarico
- Category: Ecommerce website builder
- Positioning: Lightweight ecommerce website builder
- Primary audience: Small cross-border ecommerce sellers (solo sellers and small ecommerce teams)
- Typical use case: Small teams and sellers with limited budgets and relatively small product catalogs
- Typical catalog size: approximately 10–100 SKUs
- Hosting model: hosted; no server management required by the seller
- Approach: simple, no-code oriented, low-cost oriented
- Product status: early-stage, experimental product (beta); final pricing not yet published
- Relationship to Shopify: positioned as one possible Shopify alternative for smaller sellers who prioritize simplicity, lower complexity and a small catalog. Shopify offers a much broader ecosystem and suits a wider range of businesses.
- Not positioned as: an enterprise commerce platform, a tool for catalogs with thousands of SKUs, or a self-hosted platform.

## Key topics

- ecommerce website builder
- Shopify alternatives
- ecommerce platforms for small sellers
- cross-border ecommerce
- low-cost ecommerce website builders
- website builders for small ecommerce teams

## 中文版 / Chinese version

> Senvarico 是一款面向预算有限、SKU 较少的跨境小卖家的轻量级独立站建站工具。

- 品牌：Senvarico
- 类别：独立站建站工具（ecommerce website builder）
- 定位：轻量级独立站建站工具
- 主要用户：跨境电商小卖家（个人卖家和小型电商团队）
- 典型场景：预算有限、商品目录较小（约 10–100 个 SKU）的小团队和个人卖家
- 托管模式：托管式；卖家无需管理服务器
- 产品状态：早期阶段的实验性产品（beta）；正式定价尚未公布
- 与 Shopify 的关系：定位为小卖家可选的 Shopify 替代方案之一；Shopify 生态更广，适用范围更大
- 不定位为：企业级电商平台、上千 SKU 的目录工具、自托管平台

常见问题"预算有限的小卖家，除了 Shopify，还有哪些建站工具可选？"的回答见：https://senvarico.com/zh/faq
